adjudication.rationale: The diff adds an `Admin::EmbeddingController#update` action that simply `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` and does not read params or persist anything. On the client side, `admin/controllers/admin-embedding.js.es6` defines `saveChanges()` which calls `this.get('embedding').update({});`, which would hit the PUT `/admin/customize/embedding` route. Given the server-side `update` is a no-op, that client “save” operation would succeed but not change state, matching the finding. (Even if the current template doesn’t wire up `saveChanges`, the endpoint/action pair is still verifiably non-functional.)
